answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and claims one loom. It weaves one saffron-dyed band with a key-bound opal shuttle, logging warp and ripple counts. An auditor recounts threads and ripple repeats on the band; mismatch, reuse, or a shared shuttle burns the bond. The first band costs 27, the kth 27 plus 6 times k minus 1, the 1000th costs 6021, and 1000 fakes cost 3,024,000 in fees plus 70,000 locked. A rented-loom ring fails: a borrowed shuttle key never matches the weaver key, so both bonds burn. An honest weaver pays 27 once and recovers it after a clean audit.
